oneOf.description: Two-letter language codes (Set 1) for major individual languages; widely used in web and UI contexts.
Three-letter language codes (Set 2) covering widely known languages and some language groups; maintained by the Library of Congress.
Three-letter language codes (Set 3) intended to cover all known individual languages (living, extinct, ancient); maintained by SIL International.
Three-letter language identifiers for language families/groups (Set 5); maintained by the Library of Congress.
IETF Best Current Practice 47 language tags combining ISO 639 language codes with script (ISO 15924) and region (ISO 3166), e.g., 'en-US', 'zh-Hant-TW'.
